title: Gearbox
description: Spur gear reducer: pinion, gear, shafts, bearings, split housing. Ratio = gear teeth / pinion teeth.

params.name: pinion_teeth
params.label: Pinion teeth
params.help: Teeth on the small input gear. Under 14 they get undercut.

params.name: gear_teeth
params.label: Gear teeth
params.help: Teeth on the big output gear. Ratio = gear teeth / pinion teeth.

params.name: module
params.label: Gear module
params.help: Tooth size: pitch diameter / teeth. Bigger teeth carry more load.

params.name: face_width
params.label: Face width
params.help: How wide the gears are along their shafts.

params.name: shaft_diameter
params.label: Shaft diameter
params.help: Thicker shafts are stiffer but leave less metal round the pinion's bore.
